title: settings.json lets a headless run merge any merge request and restore guard files from another revision, and does not allow the tick's digest --commit
goal: .claude/settings.json allows glab mr merge only for code/* branches, denies a checkout of paths from another revision (git checkout * -- *, which the git checkout -- * deny misses) for Bash and PowerShell, and allows python3 _tools/kbdecide.py digest --commit, the form the kb-autopilot tick runs, so an unattended loop neither merges another branch nor restores an older settings or hook file nor waits on a permission prompt; test_settings_allow asserts each with a planted failure (tests named settings_allow_review_gaps); found by the SP-zihqagoi review

run: import json,sys;a=json.load(open('.claude/settings.json'))['permissions']['allow'];sys.exit(1 if 'Bash(glab mr merge *)' in a else 0)
